# v1.4 — PDF page + all four editions aligned

JobEval turns a capable LLM (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and others) into a job-application adviser for one market. This release removes the hardest step for most candidates, turning the generated code into a PDF, and brings the four editions to the same feature level.

## Start here

1. **Download the prompt for the job's market** from the files below, or copy it on the website: <https://malonefreak.github.io/JobEval/>
2. **Paste it into a new chat**, as the first message or as project instructions. Then send your CV and one or more job ads.
3. **Turn the code into a PDF** at <https://malonefreak.github.io/JobEval/pdf.html>: paste, download. No install, no account, and your text stays in your browser.

Use one assistant per chat.

Spain means Spain, not all Spanish-speaking countries. Brazil means Brazil, not Portugal or other Portuguese-speaking countries. The United States edition is not localized for Canada. Germany is the primary DACH edition.

## What's new

**Getting the PDF**

- New PDF page: paste Typst or HTML and download the PDF. Typst compiles in the browser (pinned, integrity-checked compiler); the pasted text is never uploaded. Compile errors show the line and can be copied back to the assistant.
- Every edition now offers Typst, self-contained HTML and plain text. The format is offered at job selection, without an extra turn; Typst stays the default.
- Print-ready HTML: paper size and margins set by the file (A4, or US Letter for the US edition), an on-screen instruction line that is hidden in the PDF, no JavaScript.
- On hosts that really run code, the assistant may compile and deliver the PDF itself, reporting only what it observed.
- Step-by-step PDF guides in Portuguese, English, Spanish and German.

**All four editions**

- Consultative recruiter read after the score: likely first impression, up to three levers, perception risks, warning signs in the ad, likely screening questions, suggested decision.
- Triage mode for four or more ads.
- "Degree or equivalent experience" counts as one requirement, so a missing degree is not penalized when the accepted route is supported.
- Phase 4 offers a letter, a short application message or labelled form answers, chosen from the real channel. New for Germany and Spain.

**Fixes**

- Spain: target-change branch, STOP exemption when editing the manual, "everything at once" rule.
- Brazil: HTML margins no longer add the browser's default margin.
- Prompts moved to `prompts/` with `.txt`; the README link to the US edition is fixed; brand unified as JobEval.

Full history: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/MaloneFreak/JobEval/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Em português

Baixe o prompt do país da vaga, cole numa conversa nova e envie seu currículo e as vagas. Quando o assistente entregar o código, gere o PDF em <https://malonefreak.github.io/JobEval/pdf.html>, sem instalar nada e sem criar conta. Se preferir não lidar com código, peça `formato: html` e salve o PDF pelo navegador com Ctrl+P. Guia completo: [Do código ao PDF](https://github.com/MaloneFreak/JobEval/blob/main/docs/guides/pdf.pt-BR.md).

## What this release does not claim

This is not an ATS, Gupy, hiring, or interview-probability score. Source generation is not PDF creation. Page counts and character limits are verified only when actually counted or compiled.

The German letter uses a DIN-5008-oriented digital layout; strict Form B conformity requires verification. Inclusive wording in an advertisement is not a restricted eligibility route. This is not legal advice on AGG, LGPD, EEO, visas, or qualification recognition.
